record.paper_title: The average size of a connected vertex set of a graph-Explicit formulas and open problems
record.original_question: For every connected finite graph G in which every vertex has degree at least 3, is the connected-set density D(G)=A(G)/|V(G)| always at least 1/2, where A(G) is the average cardinality of a connected vertex subset of G?

evidence.quote: Conjecture 7. If all vertices of a graph G have degree at least 3, then D G() 1 ≥ ∕2.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $G=(V,E)$ be a finite connected graph. A subset $S\subseteq V$ is called connected if the induced subgraph $G[S]$ is connected (the empty set is excluded). Let $\mathcal{C}(G)$ denote the family of nonempty connected vertex subsets of $G$, and define the average connected-set size
$$A(G) \;=\; \frac{1}{|\mathcal{C}(G)|}\sum_{S\in \mathcal{C}(G)} |S|,$$
and the connected-set density
$$D(G) \;=\; \frac{A(G)}{|V(G)|}.$$
Prove or disprove: for every finite connected graph $G$ in which every vertex has degree at least $3$, one has
$$D(G) \;\geq\; \tfrac{1}{2}.$$
artifact.status_search_result: Haslegrave (J. Graph Theory, 2022; arXiv:2105.13332) established that the connected-set density of any graph sequence whose minimum degree tends to infinity converges to 1/2, and that D(G) is bounded away from 1 once there are no degree-2 vertices, but did not establish the sharp lower bound D(G) ≥ 1/2 for all graphs with minimum degree ≥ 3. No source located confirms a proof of this specific conjecture, which appears to remain open.

status_evidence.title: The number and average size of connected sets in graphs with degree constraints
status_evidence.snippet: Any sequence of graphs with minimum degree tending to infinity must have connected set density tending to 1/2.
status_evidence.claim: Related asymptotic result is proved, but the specific min-degree-3 conjecture D(G) ≥ 1/2 is not established.

status_evidence.title: A lower bound on the average size of a connected vertex set of a graph
status_evidence.snippet: Lower bounds on the average size of connected vertex sets.
status_evidence.claim: Work in this direction proves partial lower bounds but does not resolve the conjectured 1/2 bound for minimum degree 3.
